source: Minecraft Wiki infoboxes (https://minecraft.wiki), Java Edition values
notes: Damage is in health points (2 HP = 1 heart) dealt to a player without armour on Easy / Normal / Hard.
Difficulty only scales damage dealt to players: other mobs take the Normal value (or 'to_mobs' when given).
A number pair [min, max] is a range (bows, crossbows, iron golems, hoglins).

spawn.when: dark = light level 0 (night on the surface, any time in caves), night = surface at night or in thunderstorms, day = passive spawning with the world, any, structure, summoned, built, special, event.
added_in is the first Java Edition release with the mob. Mobs newer than mineflayer_max_version are not known to mineflayer, so a bot on such a server sees them as unknown entities.
Java 26.1 and 26.3 added no new mobs (26.1 gave baby mobs new names and models).

allay.name: Allay

spawn.where: pillager outposts (cages), woodland mansions (cells)

allay.fact: give it an item and it collects matching items for you
allay.notes: dance near a playing jukebox with an amethyst shard to duplicate it

armadillo.name: Armadillo

spawn.where: savannas and badlands

armadillo.fact: rolls up when threatened; brush it for armadillo scutes (wolf armour)

axolotl.name: Axolotl

spawn.where: water in lush caves (with clay below)

axolotl.fact: friendly underwater mob that fights drowned and guardians; carry it in a water bucket

spawn.where: caves at light level 3 or less

bee.name: Bee

spawn.where: bee nests in plains, meadows, flower forests, cherry groves

bee.fact: neutral; stings if you hit it or break its nest; use a campfire under the hive and shears for honeycomb
bee.hostile_when: you hit it or break/harvest its hive without a campfire

blaze.name: Blaze

spawn.where: Nether fortresses (light <= 11) and spawners

blaze.fact: Nether fortress mob that flies and shoots fireballs; snowballs hurt it; drops blaze rods (needed for brewing and Eyes of Ender)
drops: blaze rod 0-1 (when killed by a player)

bogged.name: Bogged

spawn.where: swamps and mangrove swamps; trial chambers

bogged.fact: swamp skeleton whose arrows cause Poison

breeze.name: Breeze

spawn.where: trial spawners in trial chambers

breeze.fact: trial chamber mob that jumps around and shoots wind charges that knock you back; drops breeze rods
weaknesses: it deflects arrows and tridents - use melee

camel.name: Camel

spawn.where: desert villages

camel.fact: desert mount for two players; breed with cactus

camel_husk.name: Camel Husk

spawn.where: Desert at light 0 with two riders: a husk with a spear and a parched

camel_husk.fact: undead camel that is harmless itself, but its husk and parched riders attack
camel_husk.tame: feed rabbit's feet to heal it; cannot be bred

cat.name: Cat

spawn.where: villages and swamp huts (black cats)

attacks.note: only against rabbits and baby turtles

cat.fact: tame with raw cod or salmon; creepers and phantoms avoid cats

cave_spider.name: Cave Spider

spawn.where: sulfur caves (since 26.2); spawners in mineshafts; trial chambers

cave_spider.fact: small spider from mineshaft spawners; its bite poisons; break the spawner or light the area

chicken.name: Chicken

spawn.where: most grassy biomes; baby zombies sometimes ride one (chicken jockey)

chicken.fact: passive; lays eggs; breed with seeds; drops raw chicken and feathers

cod.name: Cod

spawn.where: oceans (not warm ones)

cod.fact: fish; catch with a bucket or kill for food

copper_golem.name: Copper Golem

spawn.where: built from a copper block and a carved pumpkin

copper_golem.fact: sorts items: takes them out of copper chests and puts them into matching wooden chests; oxidises into a statue unless waxed

cow.name: Cow

spawn.where: most grassy biomes (plains, forests, taigas, meadows...)

cow.fact: passive; milk it with a bucket; breed with wheat; drops beef and leather

creaking.name: Creaking

spawn.where: by an active creaking heart in pale gardens at night

creaking.fact: pale garden mob that only moves when nobody looks at it; break its creaking heart to kill it
drops: resin clumps grow on logs when it is hit
creaking.health_note: immune to damage while its creaking heart exists

creeper.name: Creeper

spawn.where: most Overworld biomes

attacks.note: maximum at point blank; charged creeper 43.5 / 85 / 127.5

creeper.fact: walks up silently, hisses and EXPLODES about 1.5 s later, destroying blocks; hit it and step back, or kill it from range; cats scare it; drops gunpowder
drops: music disc if a skeleton's arrow kills it

dolphin.name: Dolphin

spawn.where: warm, lukewarm and normal oceans

dolphin.fact: gives Dolphin's Grace when you swim with it; hitting one angers nearby dolphins
dolphin.notes: feed it raw fish and it leads you to treasure

donkey.name: Donkey

spawn.where: plains, savannas and meadows

donkey.fact: tameable like a horse and can carry a chest

drowned.name: Drowned

spawn.where: rivers, oceans, dripstone caves, ocean ruins; zombies that stay underwater

drowned.fact: underwater zombie; some throw tridents from range; drops rotten flesh, sometimes copper or a trident
drowned.hostile_when: at night, or when you are in the water
drowned.notes: the baby is called a gurgle since 26.1

elder_guardian.name: Elder Guardian

spawn.where: ocean monuments (three each)

elder_guardian.fact: big monument guardian that gives Mining Fatigue; three per monument
elder_guardian.notes: gives Mining Fatigue III in a 50-block radius

ender_dragon.name: Ender Dragon

spawn.where: the End's main island

ender_dragon.fact: End boss; destroy the end crystals on the obsidian pillars first; arrows and melee when it perches

enderman.name: Enderman

spawn.where: all three dimensions (Overworld light 0, Nether light <= 7, the End)

enderman.fact: neutral until you look at its face or hit it, then teleports at you and hits hard; water hurts it; it cannot fit under a 2-block-high roof; drops ender pearls
enderman.hostile_when: you look at its face or hit it
weaknesses: a carved pumpkin on your head lets you look at it

endermite.name: Endermite

spawn.where: 5% chance when a player's ender pearl lands

endermite.fact: tiny hostile mob that sometimes appears when an ender pearl lands

evoker.name: Evoker

spawn.where: woodland mansions, raids

evoker.fact: illager that summons fangs from the ground and vexes; kill it quickly; drops a totem of undying

fox.name: Fox

spawn.where: taigas, snowy taigas, groves, dappled forests

fox.fact: night-time hunter; breed with sweet berries; holds items in its mouth
fox.hostile_when: it trusts a different player you attack

frog.name: Frog

spawn.where: swamps and mangrove swamps (variant depends on the biome)

frog.fact: eats small slimes and magma cubes; breed with slimeballs
frog.notes: eating a small magma cube drops a froglight

ghast.name: Ghast

spawn.where: nether wastes, soul sand valleys, basalt deltas

attacks.note: a fireball hit back into a ghast kills it

ghast.fact: big floating Nether mob that shoots exploding fireballs; hit a fireball back at it; drops ghast tears

glow_squid.name: Glow Squid

spawn.where: deep underwater caves in darkness

glow_squid.fact: deep water squid; drops glow ink sacs

goat.name: Goat

spawn.where: snowy slopes, jagged and frozen peaks

goat.fact: rams players and mobs off edges; drops goat horns when it hits a block
goat.notes: screaming goats ram more often; milk it with a bucket

guardian.name: Guardian

spawn.where: ocean monuments

guardian.fact: ocean monument fish that charges a laser beam; fight it in short bursts or with a bow

happy_ghast.name: Happy Ghast

spawn.where: grows from a dried ghast block placed in water (dried ghasts are found in soul sand valleys)

happy_ghast.fact: friendly flying mount for up to four players: grow a dried ghast in water, then put a harness on it
happy_ghast.notes: the baby (ghastling) grows faster when fed snowballs

hoglin.name: Hoglin

spawn.where: crimson forests, bastion remnants

hoglin.fact: hostile Nether beast that knocks you into the air; it is afraid of warped fungus; drops porkchops and leather
weaknesses: warped fungus, nether portals and respawn anchors repel it
hoglin.notes: turns into a zoglin after 15 s in the Overworld

horse.name: Horse

spawn.where: plains and savannas; villages

horse.fact: tame by mounting it until hearts appear; needs a saddle to steer; breed with golden apples or golden carrots

husk.name: Husk

spawn.where: Desert surface at night or in thunderstorms

husk.fact: desert zombie that does not burn in sunlight; its hit causes Hunger
husk.notes: turns into a zombie when submerged in water

illusioner.name: Illusioner

spawn.where: commands only (unused in survival)

illusioner.fact: rare illager that makes copies of itself and shoots arrows

iron_golem.name: Iron Golem

spawn.where: villages, pillager outposts, built from iron blocks and a pumpkin

iron_golem.fact: village protector; neutral, but attacks you if you hurt villagers; drops iron ingots and poppies
iron_golem.hostile_when: you hit it or a villager, or your village reputation is low
iron_golem.notes: player-built golems never attack their builder

llama.name: Llama

spawn.where: windswept hills, savanna plateaus

llama.fact: spits when attacked; can carry chests; tame by riding it repeatedly

magma_cube.name: Magma Cube

spawn.where: nether wastes, basalt deltas, fortresses; bastion spawners

magma_cube.fact: Nether slime that splits and is immune to fire and lava; drops magma cream

mooshroom.name: Mooshroom

spawn.where: mushroom fields

mooshroom.fact: mushroom cow; milk with a bowl for stew; breed with wheat

mule.name: Mule

spawn.where: only bred from a horse and a donkey

mule.fact: donkey-horse cross; can carry a chest; cannot breed

nautilus.name: Nautilus

spawn.where: all oceans except warm ones' surfaces

nautilus.fact: underwater mount: tame with pufferfish, saddle it and ride; protects you from drowning

ocelot.name: Ocelot

spawn.where: jungles

ocelot.fact: jungle cat; feed it raw fish to gain its trust; creepers avoid it
ocelot.notes: trusts you but cannot be tamed since 1.14

panda.name: Panda

spawn.where: jungles and bamboo jungles

panda.fact: jungle mob; breed with bamboo; aggressive pandas hit back

parched.name: Parched

spawn.where: Desert surface at night or in thunderstorms; riders of camel husks

parched.fact: desert skeleton that does not burn in sunlight and shoots arrows of Weakness
parched.notes: immune to Weakness; fires slower than a skeleton

parrot.name: Parrot

spawn.where: jungles

parrot.fact: tame with seeds; never feed it cookies

phantom.name: Phantom

spawn.where: the night sky over players who have not slept for 3+ in-game days

phantom.fact: flying night mob that only appears after you have not slept for 3+ days; sleep in a bed to stop them; drops phantom membrane

pig.name: Pig

spawn.where: most grassy biomes

pig.fact: passive; breed with carrots, potatoes or beetroot; drops porkchops; ride with a saddle and a carrot on a stick

piglin.name: Piglin

spawn.where: nether wastes, crimson forests, bastion remnants

piglin.fact: Nether mob that is neutral if you wear at least one gold armour piece, otherwise hostile; trade by dropping gold ingots; angers if you open chests or mine gold near it
piglin.hostile_when: you wear no gold armour, open chests or break gold blocks near it, or hit one
piglin.notes: babies are passive and never grow up; turns into a zombified piglin after 15 s in the Overworld

piglin_brute.name: Piglin Brute

spawn.where: bastion remnants

piglin_brute.fact: always hostile bastion guard with a gold axe; very strong - avoid
piglin_brute.notes: gold armour does not calm it

pillager.name: Pillager

spawn.where: pillager outposts, patrols, raids

pillager.fact: crossbow raider; patrols carry a banner captain whose death gives Bad Omen (a raid when you enter a village)

polar_bear.name: Polar Bear

spawn.where: snowy plains, ice spikes, frozen oceans

polar_bear.fact: neutral, hostile when a cub is near; strong - leave it alone
polar_bear.hostile_when: a cub is near you, or you hit it

pufferfish.name: Pufferfish

spawn.where: lukewarm and warm oceans

pufferfish.fact: puffs up and poisons you when close; do not eat it

rabbit.name: Rabbit

spawn.where: deserts, flower forests, taigas, meadows, cherry groves and snowy biomes

rabbit.fact: fast passive mob; breed with carrots or dandelions; drops rabbit hide and sometimes a rabbit's foot

ravager.name: Ravager

spawn.where: raids only

ravager.fact: huge raid beast that hits extremely hard - avoid or fight from range
ravager.notes: a shield block can stun it

salmon.name: Salmon

spawn.where: rivers and cold/frozen oceans

salmon.fact: fish; catch with a bucket or kill for food

sheep.name: Sheep

spawn.where: most grassy biomes

sheep.fact: passive; shear it for wool (no kill needed); breed with wheat; drops mutton

shulker.name: Shulker

spawn.where: End cities

shulker.fact: End city box mob; its bullets cause Levitation (dangerous fall damage); drops shulker shells
weaknesses: hit it while its shell is open

silverfish.name: Silverfish

spawn.where: infested stone in mountains, strongholds, igloos, mansions; Infested potion effect

silverfish.fact: hides in infested stone; hitting one wakes nearby silverfish; kill with one strong hit or avoid

skeleton.name: Skeleton

spawn.where: most Overworld biomes; soul sand valleys and fortresses in the Nether; spawners

skeleton.fact: shoots arrows from range and burns in daylight; close the distance fast or block with a shield; drops bones and arrows

skeleton_horse.name: Skeleton Horse

spawn.where: skeleton traps from lightning in thunderstorms

skeleton_horse.fact: skeleton trap horse: going near turns it into four skeleton horsemen with enchanted bows
skeleton_horse.hostile_when: as part of a skeleton trap

slime.name: Slime

spawn.where: swamps (at night) and slime chunks below y=40

slime.fact: splits into smaller slimes when killed; spawns in swamps and slime chunks; drops slimeballs

sniffer.name: Sniffer

spawn.where: hatches from a sniffer egg (from suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins)

sniffer.fact: ancient mob that digs up rare seeds
sniffer.notes: hatches from a sniffer egg; the baby is called a snifflet since 26.1

snow_golem.name: Snow Golem

spawn.where: built from 2 snow blocks and a carved pumpkin

snow_golem.fact: built from snow blocks and a pumpkin; throws snowballs at hostile mobs

spider.name: Spider

spawn.where: most Overworld biomes (not sulfur caves); spawners

spider.fact: neutral in daylight, hostile in the dark; climbs walls; drops string and spider eyes
spider.hostile_when: in the dark (it stays neutral in bright light unless hit)
drops: spider eye (1/3, when killed by a player)

squid.name: Squid

spawn.where: rivers and oceans

squid.fact: passive sea mob; drops ink sacs

stray.name: Stray

spawn.where: snowy plains and ice spikes surface; skeletons frozen in powder snow

stray.fact: snowy skeleton whose arrows cause Slowness

strider.name: Strider

spawn.where: lava seas in the Nether

strider.fact: Nether lava walker; ride it with a saddle and a warped fungus on a stick

sulfur_cube.name: Sulfur Cube

spawn.where: sulfur caves only, at any light level

attacks.type: contact with an absorbed magma block

attacks.note: maximum; 6 s fuse when lit by fire/redstone, 0.75-3 s from another explosion

sulfur_cube.fact: passive slime-like cube from sulfur caves (26.2): give it a full block and it absorbs it and changes its physics (bouncy, sliding, sticky...); TNT inside makes it explode, a magma block makes it burn you; shear the block out; small cubes grow with slimeballs
sulfur_cube.hostile_when: never on purpose - only if it has absorbed TNT (explodes) or a magma block (burns on contact)
sulfur_cube.health_note: large 8, small 4 (a large cube splits into two small ones when it dies)
sulfur_cube.notes: Added in the Chaos Cubed drop, Java 26.2 (June 16, 2026). Counts against the hostile mob cap and despawns like a monster. With a block inside it ignores melee, fall and explosion damage but not lava or fire. Large cubes can be picked up with a bucket.

tadpole.name: Tadpole

spawn.where: hatches from frogspawn

tadpole.fact: baby frog; carry it in a water bucket; grows into a frog

trader_llama.name: Trader Llama

spawn.where: with a wandering trader

trader_llama.fact: llama of the wandering trader; spits at attackers
trader_llama.hostile_when: you attack it or its trader

tropical_fish.name: Tropical Fish

spawn.where: warm oceans, lush caves and mangrove swamps

tropical_fish.fact: colourful fish; catch it with a bucket

turtle.name: Turtle

spawn.where: beaches

turtle.fact: lays eggs on its home beach; breed with seagrass; drops scutes when babies grow up

vex.name: Vex

spawn.where: summoned by evokers

vex.fact: small flying mob summoned by evokers; flies through walls; dies on its own after a while

villager.name: Villager

spawn.where: villages; cured zombie villagers

villager.fact: trades items for emeralds; never hurt villagers (golems attack you); a bed and a job block make it work
villager.breed: give them food (bread, carrots, potatoes, beetroots) with free beds

vindicator.name: Vindicator

spawn.where: woodland mansions, raids

vindicator.fact: axe-wielding illager that hits very hard; keep distance or use a shield

wandering_trader.name: Wandering Trader

spawn.where: near players every now and then

wandering_trader.fact: visits now and then and sells rare items for emeralds; despawns after a while
drops: potion or milk bucket it drinks

warden.name: Warden

spawn.where: when sculk shriekers in the deep dark are triggered 4 times

warden.fact: blind deep-dark monster that hunts by sound and smell and is far too strong to fight; sneak, do not trigger sculk shriekers, and leave if it appears

witch.name: Witch

spawn.where: most Overworld biomes; swamp huts; raids; villagers struck by lightning

witch.fact: throws poison, slowness, weakness and harming potions and drinks healing potions; fight it fast or from range
drops: glass bottle, glowstone dust, gunpowder, redstone, spider eye, stick, sugar (0-6 total)

wither.name: Wither

spawn.where: built from 4 soul sand/soil and 3 wither skeleton skulls

attacks.effect: Wither II (10 s Normal, 40 s Hard)

wither.fact: boss built from soul sand and 3 wither skeleton skulls; explodes and shoots skulls; only fight it fully prepared
weaknesses: below half health arrows bounce off

wither_skeleton.name: Wither Skeleton

spawn.where: Nether fortresses (light <= 7)

wither_skeleton.fact: Nether fortress skeleton with a stone sword; its hit causes the Wither effect; sometimes drops a wither skeleton skull

wolf.name: Wolf

spawn.where: forests, taigas, groves, savanna plateaus, wooded badlands

wolf.fact: tame with bones; tamed wolves follow and fight for you; hitting a wild one angers the pack

zoglin.name: Zoglin

spawn.where: a hoglin that spends 15 s outside the Nether

zoglin.fact: zombified hoglin, attacks every mob nearby

zombie.name: Zombie

spawn.where: most Overworld biomes; zombie sieges; spawners

zombie.fact: hostile melee mob; burns in daylight unless it wears a helmet or stands in shade/water; baby zombies are fast; drops rotten flesh
drops: rarely iron ingot, carrot or potato

zombie_horse.name: Zombie Horse

spawn.where: plains and savannas at night with a spear-wielding zombie rider (since 1.21.11)

zombie_horse.fact: undead horse; dangerous only while a zombie rides it; once alone it can be tamed and ridden

zombie_nautilus.name: Zombie Nautilus

spawn.where: oceans and dripstone caves, ridden by a drowned with a trident

zombie_nautilus.fact: undead nautilus; hostile only while a drowned rides it; tame it with pufferfish
zombie_nautilus.hostile_when: while a hostile mob rides it

zombie_villager.name: Zombie Villager

spawn.where: replaces some zombies; villagers killed by zombies on Normal/Hard

zombie_villager.fact: zombie villager; cure it with a splash potion of weakness then a golden apple to get a villager back

zombified_piglin.name: Zombified Piglin

spawn.where: nether wastes, crimson forests, fortresses; near Overworld portals; pigs struck by lightning

zombified_piglin.fact: neutral Nether mob; hitting one makes the whole group attack you; drops gold nuggets
zombified_piglin.hostile_when: you (or anything you do) hurt one - the whole group joins
